sentences.text: Prabir Saha vs Unknown on 11 June, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 26
11-06-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 1704 of 2024
In the matter of : Prabir Saha ..... petitioner.

Mr. Aniruddha
Bhattacharyya Mr. Parvez Mallick ...for the petitioner

. Mr. Debasish Roy Mr. Arijit Ganguly Ms.
Sreemoyi Roy ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken on record.
The petitioner seeks expeditious disposal of the proceeding being GR Case no.732 of 2010 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 4th Court, Howrah.
Charge was framed in the said proceeding under Sections 498A/323/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code on 4th April, 2012 and since then several dates were fixed for evidence of witnesses.
The next date for adducing evidence has been fixed on 7 th December, 2024.
Since the matter is pretty old and is pending for a considerable period, the learned Trial Court is directed to dispose of the matter within six months from the next date of evidence fixed before it.
The revisional application is accordingly disposed of.
Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.

( Suvra Ghosh, J. )
